# Support

## Getting help

- For reproducible bugs, use the [bug report form](https://github.com/MaxAndreev27/dl-rocm-demo/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- For feature ideas, use the [feature request form](https://github.com/MaxAndreev27/dl-rocm-demo/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- For usage questions, check the [README troubleshooting notes](../README.md#notes-and-troubleshooting), then [open a blank issue](https://github.com/MaxAndreev27/dl-rocm-demo/issues/new) with your operating system, GPU model, Python version, PyTorch version, and relevant error output.

This project is a small demo, not a general ROCm support service. Results and compatibility depend on the GPU, driver, and ROCm/PyTorch wheel versions.

Do not post credentials, private data, or security vulnerability details in public issues.
